Alberto has built three AI agents:

1. **Fraud Detection Agent** (offline-evals): Reviews events and organizers on a ticketing platform, recommending approve/reject/request-info with reasons. It auto-approves only when evidence is verified in code; web sources can hold decisions back but never approve. Offline evals showed significant improvements: fraud approved without human review dropped from 27% to 0%, and accuracy improved from 71% to 86% with Claude Haiku 5.5.

2. **Organizer Support Agent** (coming-soon): Answers event organizers' questions about sales, payouts, and setup without human review, pulling live data from PostgreSQL and the payments API.

3. **Portfolio Agent** (personal-project): Answers visitors' questions about his experience and projects in natural language on this portfolio site, also exposed as an MCP server for external agents to query.

1. **Fraud Detection Agent** (status: offline-evals)  
   - Context: An online event ticketing platform  
   - Description: Reviews newly published events and organizers, recommending approve/reject/request-info with reasons for a human admin. It auto-approves only on evidence verified in code; web sources can hold decisions back but never approve.

   - Stack: TypeScript, PostgreSQL, GCP

   - Context: An online event ticketing platform  
   - Description: Answers event organizers' questions about sales, payouts and setup without human review, pulling live data from PostgreSQL and the payments API.  
   - Stack: TypeScript, Tool calling, MCP, PostgreSQL  

3. **Portfolio Agent** (status: personal-project)  
   - Context: This portfolio site  
   - Description: An agent on his portfolio site that answers visitors' questions about his experience and projects in natural language. Also exposed as an MCP server so external agents can query it.  
   - Stack: TypeScript, Claude, MCP  
   - Links: [source](https://github.com/acarbonellb/acb-landing-public/tree/main/agent), [eval report](https://github.com/acarbonellb/acb-landing-public/blob/main/agent/evals/report.md)  

Alberto also follows practices like offline evals before shipping, graded autonomy with a human in the loop, tracking cost and limits, and measuring changes run over run.
